asset.name: HoldToConfirm
asset.description: The deliberate-action control requiring sustained activation, showing progress toward commitment, supporting cancellation, and always offering a keyboard-accessible alternative.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Pointer, touch, keyboard, press, and focus-visible behavior is owned once rather than reimplemented.
Sustained activation shares movement tolerance and cancellation.
Commitment progress is shown through the shared progress primitive.

signatureMoment.description: Holding visibly fills toward commitment and releasing early visibly unwinds, so the user feels the weight of the action before it happens.
